_meta.description: A task is named after its subject (openspec change round5-contact-create-and-task-links). The crmTask schema had no objectNameField, and its title property is `subject`, which OpenRegister's name fallback (name, naam, title, titel) does not look at. So every task's name was its uuid: the activity stream read 'Task <uuid> updated' and the task page heading fell back to the page title 'Task'. A bare field path is enough here because `subject` is a plain string, not a relation. Existing tasks get their name on their next save, like leadProduct in 97-lead-line-names-and-score. No property changes.
